readme.summary: Excellent README with clear purpose, multi-platform install options, practical quick-start examples, and solid coverage of roles/MFA, but lacks troubleshooting guidance and defers detailed configuration to an external USAGE.md.
readme.top_issue: No troubleshooting section — common problems like keychain permission errors, MFA issues, or credential expiration are not addressed in the README.
